name: basehalf-ai-video
description: The provider requests of BaseHalf's Video node, a starter video workflow, and Sequence playback.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Video nodes send requests to the video providers set up on this computer and write their videos into the workspace.

basehalfAgentCapabilities.label: Video Workflow Documents
basehalfAgentCapabilities.description: Describe shots and arrange Video nodes that hold a video, without adding another canvas, editor, or renderer.

documents.schemaSummary: A shot.json root object with version 1, kind pointa.basehalf-ai-video.shot, a stable id, a title, and clipNodePath ending in .bhnode. clipNodePath is relative to the directory containing that shot.json file.

A video-sequence.json root object with version 1, kind pointa.basehalf-ai-video.sequence, and ordered items. Every item requires a unique id, title, stable nodeId, and videoNodePath ending in .bhnode relative to the directory containing video-sequence.json. The referenced node must be a Video node that holds a video whose file exists.

operations.description: Check that every referenced node is a Video node that holds a video whose file exists, without changing the Sequence.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file in the open local workspace.

returns.description: Validation status and the state of each item's Video node.

operations.description: Append one Video node that holds a video to playback order.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: videoNode
parameters.description: URI of a Video node that holds a video, under the workflow root containing video-sequence.json.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Unique stable id for the new Sequence item.

returns.description: The add operation, saved item, saved Sequence document, and fresh inspection.

operations.description: Move one Video node reference by one position in playback order.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item to move.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Move the item one position earlier or later.

returns.description: The saved Sequence document after the move.

operations.description: Remove one playback-order reference and keep its Video node and video.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item to remove.

returns.description: The remove operation, removed item, saved Sequence document, and fresh inspection.

operations.description: Repair one moved clip path after a bounded scan finds exactly one Video node with the same identity that holds a video.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item whose missing path should be repaired.

returns.description: Fresh Sequence inspection after the explicit path repair.

basehalfCanvasTemplates.label: Video Starter Workflow
basehalfCanvasTemplates.description: A brief, a script, and a first shot as ordinary notes, empty Video nodes, and an empty Sequence.
